intents.title: Identify undone turns by commit_sha across every ref
intents.statement: Replace the HEAD-only git log -n 50 scan and the 15-turn window with one reachability set from git rev-list --all, checked against Turn.commit_sha first, and a lazy all-refs AFWE-Turn trailer index only when the sha is absent or unreachable.

intents.title: Rewind reconciliation annotates instead of deleting
intents.statement: Stop deleting generated checks and flagging memory on a rewind classification; mark affected checks dormant, leave memory untouched, and log a receipt. A git failure yields no verdict rather than an undo.

intents.title: File-hash mismatch becomes advisory only
intents.statement: Keep the pre-commit baseline hash comparison as a non-mutating possible-rewind annotation until tree snapshots land in P2, so file-level rewinds stay visible without triggering a status change.

intents.title: New RewindVerdict label for reconciliation events
intents.statement: RewindVerdict distinguishes a confirmed rewind from an advisory possible one and is carried in every RollbackEvent returned to turn.begin.
